bio: In the heart of Milan's Certosa District, Abba is set in a former brush factory and welcomes guests with Nordic elegance: an open kitchen, only eight well-spaced tables, minimalist furnishings, and natural light streaming through large windows. Two tasting menus guide the experience, but à la carte options are available at lunch. The cuisine, crafted by chef Abbattista, is modern, bold, and deeply contemporary....
